text:
nina: FYI: scheduling a staggered reboot+NIC microcode window for preemptible-gpu cohort in az3 tonight 01:50-03:10 UTC. Goal: apply microcode and pick up kernel backports. Expect transient capacity loss and KV cache refill.
aj: How many nodes and expected impact?
nina: 5 nodes in cohort. Single-node drain ~10-12m. Peak available-GPU drop about 6-11% during window. Backfill should stabilize within 20-30m after finishing.
kevin: Can we pre-seed KV caches on warmbackfill nodes? p95 is sensitive for chat routes.
lia: Plan: 20m preheat with `kv_seed.py` to dedicated pool + override autoscaler to add 1 extra replica. Command: `python infra/kv_seed.py --region az3 --target dedicated-pool`. Will run 01:30Z.
aj: What are abort criteria?
nina: Abort if p95 > 450ms for 3m, or error-rate increases >1% over baseline for 5m, or more than 1 unexpected pod crash during a drain. Full thresholds in playbook.
sre-bot: Reminder: attach preflight run and perf snapshots. Run `infra preflight --cohort az3` 30m before.
kevin: Also recommend throttling batch jobs to avoid OOM spikes: set `BATCH_CONCURRENCY=1` for the window or patch cronjob concurrencyPolicy to `Forbid`. Lia?
lia: I'll patch cronjob `embeddings-batch` to `Forbid` 15m before start and revert 30m after completion. Patch: `kubectl patch cronjob embeddings-batch -n ml-jobs -p '{"spec":{"concurrencyPolicy":"Forbid"}}'`. I'll post revert command once tested.
nina: Router config change: set `latency_threshold_ms:300` and fallback to `dedicated-variant` if exceeded. Kevin, can you validate in staging?
kevin: Will validate routing + fallback in staging by 23:00 local. Also I will add a temporary experiment to route 5% of traffic to dedicated pool during the first node to monitor delta.
igh-oncall: (typo corrected) night-oncall: I'm assigned for the shift, will monitor Dashboards/PD. Please ping if thresholds breach.
lia: Playbook: https://confluence.internal/infra/preemptible-az3-maint. It includes rollback steps, sqs drain hints, and exact kubectl snippets.
nina: Cost note: temporary backfill to dedicated pool ~0.9 GPU-hours ~estimate $35. Logged to infra-maint cost center.
aj: Any pinned tenant exceptions?
nina: Two tenants with pinned pods were notified earlier today. Ops ticket INF-901 tracks confirmation; they acknowledged.
kevin: Small suggestion: add 1-min rolling delay between cordon->drain operations to give autoscaler time to react.
nina: Good call. We'll wait 60s between node steps. Final checklist: preheat KV + scale dedicated, pause batch concurrency, run preflight, cordon & drain nodes one at a time (60s gap), apply microcode, smoke tests, monitor p50/p95, revert patches, announce completion.
sre-bot: Automated status page post scheduled for start time.
nina: Thanks all. I'll post a 30m preflight update and pin this thread. :thumbsup:
